item.title: New Imaging Technology Could Transform How Doctors See Inside the Human Body
item.description: A new imaging system developed by researchers at California Institute of Technology and the University of Southern California can create fast, full-color 3D images that show both body structure and blood flow in a single scan.

item.title: AI Driven Home Buying
item.description: An AI-powered real estate platform called Homa is enabling homebuyers to complete much of the homebuying process without using a traditional buyer’s agent, with plans to expand into Texas.
